It was unforeseeable that the unexpectedly developing COVID-19 process would affect human life and daily activities to this extent. Many activities in human life either stopped entirely or were carried on through alternative methods in safer ways. The education–teaching activity, which holds vital importance in our lives, was also continued through distance education since in-person instruction was no longer possible. It was a significant advantage that, prior to this process, our Ministry had already undertaken important work related to distance education and had made practices actively available for use by students and teachers. The transition from face-to-face education to distance learning in teaching brought about many adjustments for both teachers and students. It is understood that the Ministry, making considerable efforts to ensure efficiency in education and teaching, implemented important practices during this period. On this subject, teachers shared the following views. Teacher 1: “The rapid delivery of EBA login passwords, time coordination, the reassuring and encouraging effects of public statements made according to the prevailing situation on students and parents, and the prompt launch of TV channels are the results of the efforts made by our ministry.”

Teacher 3: “Of course, since it was an unprepared situation, it is not sufficient.” Improvement efforts are underway. The scope of implementation can be expanded.”

Teacher 4: “The fact that the Ministry was able to make decisions quickly and carry out the necessary preparations in a short time shows, in my opinion, that it was sufficiently prepared.”

Teacher 6: “I think the Ministry of National Education managed the process well in a short period of time.” Although it may not be functional, it is promising that efforts are being made. As for us teachers, I think we were caught completely unprepared.”

Teacher 8: “If we consider that both the Ministry of National Education and the teachers contributed to this process with only a one-week delay and that uninterrupted education was able to continue, I think the process was managed successfully.”

Teacher 10: “In a short period, lessons started not only through EBA but also via television.” A plan and program were prepared, and assistance was requested from both families and teachers to ensure our children's adaptation to the process. It is actually a comprehensive struggle. Is it enough then? No, it isn’t! Can we do better? Of course we can! I believe that efforts are being made for better each day, learning lessons from every day. Both the Ministry of National Education and we as teachers will continue to do our best for our students.” Some teachers expressing that they were caught unprepared suggests that the EBA platform, which existed prior to COVID-19, was not actively used by some teachers. Teacher 4 stated, “The situation developed suddenly, but initially, not much time was given to teachers.” I think that especially parents have developed very high expectations of teachers, but nevertheless, teachers have also managed the process well.”  
Teacher 6: “It is promising that efforts are being made by the Ministry. As for us teachers, I think we were caught completely unprepared.

Öğrt.7: “Teachers were caught unprepared for this process. There are teachers who were unable to participate in relevant trainings.”

Öğrt.10: “Since the process we are in is an extraordinary situation, we may have deficiencies such as the necessary infrastructure and content arrangements.”

Öğrt.11: “Teachers were not prepared.” The Ministry of National Education made great efforts. Everything happened very suddenly, but everyone managed to adapt in a short time.”

Word Cloud and Word Tree Generated with NVivo 10
A word cloud can be generated with NVivo to identify the most frequently mentioned words and to extract the concepts that are heavily emphasized. It is known that as the font size increases in word clouds, the frequency of the mentioned word in the interview data also rises. In this way, prominent concepts and highlighted expressions can be visualized. Figure 5: Word Cloud  
According to the word cloud obtained in the study, words such as distance education, course, students, and EBA were frequently mentioned in the interviews. With the extraction of preliminary statements related to qualitative data from the word cloud, in order to obtain information such as the locations of these statements within written texts and their sequences with other concepts, and to examine their relationships, a word tree was created. It was found that the most frequently occurring concept was "distance education." According to the word tree generated around this concept, word groups commonly used together with distance education were visualized. To enhance the readability of the visual, the word tree was presented in two sections. Figure 2: Distance Education Word Tree -1 Some of the findings obtained from this section of the word tree include the perception of distance education as a savior, the responsibilities assigned to families during this process, the limited activeness of students in distance education, and the Ministry's rapid action during the virus period. Figure 3: Distance Education Word Tree -2

Some of the findings obtained from the word tree for this section are that distance education was considered the best alternative during this compulsory period, the method was insufficient for practice-based courses such as music, teachers received in-service training to use distance education, and the adequacy of the infrastructure for distance education. Discussion and Conclusion  
The compulsory conduct of courses in digital environments has had various repercussions from different perspectives. Although the dominant opinion among teachers is that distance education cannot replace face-to-face education conducted in classroom settings, it is acknowledged that in this extraordinary period where in-person education is not possible, the best solution remains distance education. Sindiani (2020) also stated in his study that distance education was the best option during this process. While all stakeholders were affected by the process in different ways, studies have shown that during the COVID-19 period, when students were separated from face-to-face education, they experienced significant levels of depression and feelings of loneliness (Lee, Ward, Chang, and Downing, 2020), as well as decreased levels of happiness and physical activity (Munasinghe et al., 2020). For this reason, in order to increase the usability and effectiveness of distance education, students’ motivation and satisfaction levels should be maximized, and their needs should be met as much as possible. Indeed, Patricia (2020) states that motivation, self-efficacy, and the use of technology play a significant role in students' academic performance. Teachers perceive distance education not as an adequate and complete instructional method, but rather as a tool for various reasons such as preventing students from falling behind in their lessons, keeping them engaged with the educational environment, and avoiding a holiday mindset. Kürtüncü and Kurt (2020, p. 71) also found that students were dissatisfied with not being able to conduct instructional activities face-to-face. Patricia (2020) and Sindiani (2020) also stated in their studies that during the COVID-19 period, students preferred face-to-face education over distance education. In contrast, Qazi et al. In contrast, (2020) reported that students who were able to participate in remote education expressed satisfaction with the method. In order to reach all students through remote education and ensure that all stakeholders benefit, it is necessary to provide adequate technical infrastructure even in rural areas and to make accessibility possible in terms of both software and hardware. Morgan (2020) and Carrillo and Flores (2020) also found that students without a computer or internet access at home experienced a decline compared to face-to-face education. The provision of internet services and the socio-economic status of families play a role in access to these resources. Differences in access among students lead to unequal opportunities (Bennett, Uink, and Cross, 2020). Indeed, it has been determined that the number of students in our country who were unable to benefit from distance education services during the pandemic was at significant levels, and that this inequality of opportunity reduced the quality of education (Yılmaz, Güner, Mutlu, Doğanay, and Yılmaz, 2020, p. 25). In contrast to these findings, Kang and Zhang (2020) found that online education during this period increased learning levels and motivation. It has been found that teachers' approaches to distance education vary according to their subject area. While teachers of theoretically oriented courses generally find the method sufficient in instruction, teachers of practical courses may find it inadequate. However, according to the study by Koçoğlu, Ulu Kalın, Tekdal, and Yiğen (2020, p. 2961), teachers found the remote education activities conducted to be sufficient regardless of the subject or educational level. There have been those who argue that exams should be conducted remotely, those who argue that they should be held face-to-face, and those who argue that there should be no exams at all. However, while traditional face-to-face education tends to emphasize outcomes, during distance education, the activities carried out throughout the process have been highlighted as more important for learning, thus emphasizing the significance of the process itself. It has also been understood that students do not find remote exams reliable or realistic; instead, it has been suggested that assignments to be given throughout the process would be more appropriate than online exams (Kürtüncü & Kurt, 2020, p. 66). Teachers occasionally used the Zoom software for online education; however, following the Ministry’s recommendation due to various security vulnerabilities of Zoom, they stopped using it. Most of those who had used it continued their teaching activities only through the EBA platform and EBA TV. This situation indicates the need for a reliable live lesson software. Television-based lessons may not meet the needs for online classes. As is well known, live lesson software enables two-way communication and allows for significantly greater interaction. It has been recognized that there is a need for in-service training regarding the use of distance education systems such as EBA platforms and the teaching of practical lessons through distance education. Kırmızıgül (2020, p. 288) also emphasized the need for in-service training for teachers in his study on this particular process. Not all teachers took an active role in the very large, student-oriented organization that included approximately 18 million students in primary, secondary, and high schools (Can, 2020, p. 43). Indeed, in distance education, a teacher delivering online lessons to a large number of students does not significantly impact the quality of instruction as it does in face-to-face education. Therefore, in-service training can be provided to teachers gradually, and those who have received such training can be assigned to distance education. It is important that teachers who will be involved in distance education are competent in this field and in areas such as the use of information technologies (Can, 2020, p. 30). The proficiency of teachers in using technologies for distance teaching, students’ access to information tools, and teachers’ in-service training are among the most important factors for the success of the distance education process (König, Jäger-Biela, and Glutsch, 2020). According to Nuland, Mandzuk, Petrick, and Cooper (2020), teacher training is necessary and important for the use of distance education software and for managing the process successfully. While the monitoring of educational tasks assigned to students can be effectively carried out thanks to the strong interaction of face-to-face education, in distance education, the completion of these tasks and extracurricular activities by students is open to abuse. It is difficult to conduct and monitor these activities effectively. Cooperation with parents is of great importance for the effective execution and achievement of these activities, and indeed the entire distance education process. At this point, the importance of discipline in education and instruction comes to the forefront. Teachers have mentioned various shortcomings regarding the use of distance education in its different aspects. Tang, Abuhmaid, Olaimat, Oudat, Aldhaeebi, and Bamanger (2020) also reported that the use of distance education alone was generally not satisfactory in terms of class participation, assessment and evaluation, and students’ learning levels. Distance education is necessary and important to be used not only in special situations such as during a pandemic, but at every stage of the educational process. Indeed, while face-to-face education continues, students, teachers, and parents—either intentionally or unintentionally—make use of distance education, whether through social media platforms or by using other tools. Even outside the pandemic process, although distance education is used effectively, the continued reliance on face-to-face education has brought blended learning—the combination of these two methods—to the forefront. The Ministry of National Education announced that following the return to face-to-face education after COVID-19, distance education would also continue, and that face-to-face and distance education would be integrated and used together. This decision indicates a desire to take advantage of the benefits offered by distance education. This significant development shows that the situations identified during distance education will remain relevant in subsequent periods of the educational process. Yılmaz, Güner, Mutlu, Doğanay, and Yılmaz (2020, p. 39) also concluded in their study that rather than using distance education exclusively for teaching and learning, it would be more appropriate to use it as a supplementary tool. Based on the research findings, the following recommendations were developed. Internet infrastructure can be developed to provide internet service to rural areas as much as possible. - Student participation can be increased by providing more students with access to computers and the internet. - To obtain more realistic results, the assessment and evaluation process can be extended over time. - Online in-service training seminars can be organized on the use of systems employed in distance education. - The effectiveness of distance education can be enhanced by supporting EBA materials with interactive materials and videos to be prepared for applied courses. Measures to increase internet bandwidth can be taken to enable faster use of online and offline environments. In order to provide a safer distance education process, domestic and secure live lesson software can be developed. References

Corona Virüs (Covid-19) Nedeniyle Mecburi Yürütülen
Uzaktan Eğitim Hakkında Öğretmen Görüşleri*
Bu çalışma ile COVID-19 sürecinde mecburi olarak yürütülen uzaktan eğitim hakkında öğretmen görüşleri araştırılmıştır. Bu kapsamda, süreçte aktif olarak kullanılan yazılımlardan Zoom adlı canlı ders yazılımına, çevrimdışı eğitim amaçlı kullanılan Eğitim Bilişim Ağı (EBA) platformuna, tek yönlü iletişim amaçlı kullanılan EBA TV’ ye odaklanılmıştır. Bu sistemlerin öğrenme üzerindeki etkilerini, genel olarak uzaktan eğitimin öğrenme, öğrenci ve öğretmen üzerindeki etkilerini, uzaktan eğitim ve bahsedilen sistemler hakkında öğretmenlerin tespitlerini ortaya çıkarmak amaçlanmıştır. Görüşme formu kullanılarak nitel verilerin elde edildiği araştırma olgubilim modelindedir. Araştırmaya 2019-2020 eğitim - öğretim yılında Hatay il merkezinde 7 farklı devlet okulunda görev yapan 5’ i kadın, 7’ si erkek toplam 12 öğretmen katılmıştır. Görüşülen öğretmenlerin tamamı COVID-19 dolayısıyla mecburi yürütülen uzaktan eğitim sürecinde aktif olarak görev almışlardır.

Fatih BALAMAN & Sevil HANBAY TİRYAKİ  
Teachers’ Opinions on Mandatory Distance Education Implemented Due to Coronavirus (Covid-19)*  
This study investigates teachers’ opinions on the mandatory distance education conducted during the COVID-19 process. In this context, the focus is placed on Zoom, the live lesson software actively used during the process, the Education Informatics Network (EBA) platform used for offline education purposes, and EBA TV, which is utilized for one-way communication. The aim is to reveal the effects of these systems on learning, the general impact of distance education on learning, students, and teachers, as well as teachers’ assessments of distance education and the aforementioned systems. The research, in which qualitative data were obtained using an interview form, is designed as a phenomenological model. The study involved 12 teachers—5 women and 7 men—working at 7 different public schools in the city center of Hatay in the 2019-2020 academic year. All interviewed teachers actively participated in the process of mandatory distance education implemented due to COVID-19.

discourses.source_txt: İçerik Analizi yönteminin kullanıldığı araştırmada verilerin analizde NVivo 10 yazılımından da yararlanılmıştır. Bu yazılımdan özellikle kodlamalarda, kodlamaların bir araya getirilerek temaların oluşturulmasında, tema ve alt temaların frekansları ile birlikte modellenmesinde, sık geçen kelimelerin tespitinde, kelime ağacı ve kelime bulutu oluşturma gibi sorgulamalarda yararlanılmıştır. İçerik Analizi sonunda temalar oluşturulmuş, temalara ilişkin maddelerin frekans değerlerine yer verilmiştir. Analiz sonunda “COVID-19 süreci özelinde karşılaşılan durumlar”, “Uzaktan eğitimin sağladığı kolaylıklar”, “Uzaktan eğitimde karşılaşılan dezavantajlar”, “Süreç boyunca hissedilen ihtiyaçlar” temalarına ulaşılmıştır. Temalar bağlamında birçok sonuç elde edilmiş olup bu sonuçlardan; bakanlıkça sunulan imkânların yeterli görülmesi, eğitim sistemimizin bu sürece hazırlıklı olduğunun düşünülmesi, yerli ve güvenli canlı ders yazılımı ihtiyacı, öğretmenlerin uzaktan eğitimi yüz yüze eğitim kadar etkili görmemeleri dikkat çekici olanlarıdır. Ayrıca uzaktan eğitimde ölçme – değerlendirme problemi, öğrencilerin teknik altyapı ve imkânlar açısından eşit şartlarda olmaması, hizmet içi eğitim ihtiyacı, öğrencilerin derse devam durumları da önemli sonuçlar arasındadır.
discourses.translated_txt: In the study, which employed the Content Analysis method, the data were also analyzed using NVivo 10 software. This software was particularly utilized for coding, grouping codes to form themes, modeling the frequencies of themes and subthemes, identifying frequently occurring words, and conducting queries such as generating word trees and word clouds. As a result of the Content Analysis, themes were identified and the frequency values of the items related to these themes were provided. At the end of the analysis, the following themes were revealed: “Situations encountered specifically during the COVID-19 process,” “Conveniences provided by distance education,” “Disadvantages encountered in distance education,” and “Needs felt throughout the process.” Many findings were obtained within the context of these themes; among the notable ones are the perception that the resources provided by the ministry are adequate, the belief that our education system was prepared for this process, the need for a domestic and secure live lesson software, and teachers’ perception that distance education is not as effective as face-to-face education. Additionally, the problem of assessment and evaluation in distance education, students not being on equal footing in terms of technical infrastructure and resources, the need for in-service training, and students’ attendance in lessons are also among the important findings.

discourses.source_txt: Sonuçlardan hareketle COVID-19 sonrasında uzaktan eğitim ile ilgili tespit edilen eksikler tamamlanıp, gereksinimler yerine getirildikten sonra yüz yüze eğitim ile uzaktan eğitimin harmanlanabilir. Böylece hem uzaktan eğitimin hem de yüz yüze eğitimin avantajlarından yararlanılabilir.
discourses.translated_txt: Based on the results, after addressing the identified shortcomings and fulfilling the necessary requirements regarding distance education following COVID-19, face-to-face education and distance education can be blended. In this way, the advantages of both distance and face-to-face education can be utilized.

Introduction  
During this period when the entire world is struggling with COVID-19, according to data from the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), the closure of educational institutions has affected a total of 1 billion 646 million students in 172 countries throughout the process (UNESCO, 2020). In this period, the distance education system has been used for conducting educational activities, and distance education has attracted more attention in terms of the continuity of education.

On the same date, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared this infectious disease a pandemic worldwide (WHO, 2020a). COVID-19 spreads from person to person very quickly and easily.

For this reason, methods that minimize contact between people—such as social isolation, the use of personal protective equipment like masks and gloves, and maintaining social distance—have become highly important in preventing transmission (WHO, 2020b).

discourses.source_txt: Zira insanlar arasında yakın temas kurulması, yüksek hareketlilik ve toplu taşıma araçları, ortak kullanım alanları enfeksiyonun hızla yayılmasına neden olan unsurlardır (Hang, 2020). İlk vakaların görüldüğü Çin’de yapılan çalışmalarda toplu yaşam alanlarında insan hareketlerinin yeniden düzenlenmesi gerektiğine karar verilmiştir. Bu kapsamda okulların kapatılmış, insanların evlerinde kalmaları önerilmiş, toplu yaşam alanlarının kullanımı kısıtlanmıştır. Böylece COVID-19 vaka sayısının kontrol altına alınması yolunda bu tedbirlerin etkili olduğu görülmüştür (Gu, Jiang, Zhao ve Zheng, 2020; Tian vd., 2020; Akt: Deniz ve Evci Kiraz, 2020, s. 148). Türkiye’de de COVID-19 ile mücadele kapsamında birçok önlem alınmış, alınan önlemlerden bir tanesi de okullarda derse ara verilmesi olmuştur. Bu kapsamda alınan tedbirleri açıklayan Milli Eğitim Bakanı Ziya Selçuk, haftalık ders programlarının yapılandırılarak, Eğitim Bilişim Ağı (EBA) ile internet üzerinden ve Türkiye Radyo Televizyon Kurumu (TRT) ile televizyondan gerekli telafi eğitimi desteği sunulacağını açıklamıştır (Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı [MEB], 2020). Buna göre derslerin COVID-19 sürecinde uzaktan eğitimle yürütülmesi alınan önlemlerden bir tanesi olmuş, milyonlarca öğrenci ve öğretmen için uzaktan eğitim süreci başlamıştır.
discourses.translated_txt: Close contact between people, high mobility, public transportation, and shared spaces are factors that cause infections to spread rapidly (Hang, 2020). Studies conducted in China, where the initial cases emerged, determined that human movement within communal living areas needed to be reorganized. Within this scope, schools were closed, people were advised to stay at home, and the use of communal spaces was restricted. These measures proved effective in bringing the number of COVID-19 cases under control (Gu, Jiang, Zhao, & Zheng, 2020; Tian et al., 2020; as cited in Deniz & Evci Kiraz, 2020, p. 148). In Turkey as well, numerous measures were implemented to combat COVID-19, one of which was the suspension of classes in schools. Explaining the measures taken, Minister of National Education Ziya Selçuk announced that weekly lesson schedules would be restructured and that required remedial education support would be provided online through the Education Informatics Network (EBA) and on television through the Turkish Radio and Television Corporation (TRT) (Ministry of National Education [MNE], 2020). Accordingly, conducting classes via distance education during the COVID-19 process became one of the measures taken, and the distance education process began for millions of students and teachers.

discourses.source_txt: Fiziksel, sosyal, ekonomik gibi farklı şartlarda olan bireylerden oluşan geniş kitlelere eğitim imkânı sağlayan uzaktan eğitim farklı araçlarla yürütülebilmektedir. Giderek gelişen teknoloji uzaktan eğitimde kullanılan araçları da geliştirmiş ve değiştirmiştir.
discourses.translated_txt: Distance education, which provides educational opportunities to large groups of individuals with different physical, social, and economic conditions, can be conducted through various means. The continuously advancing technology has also developed and transformed the tools used in distance education.

discourses.source_txt:
Basılı metinlerle, mektuplarla başlayıp programlı metinlerden ders kitaplarına kadar uzanan basılı materyaller teknolojinin gelişimi ile farklı ortamlar aracılığı ile de

discourses.translated_txt: Starting with printed texts and letters, and extending to programmed texts and textbooks, printed materials have also been delivered through different media as technology has developed.

discourses.source_txt: Teyp, radyo, televizyon, film ve sunumların olduğu çoklu ortamlar, bilgisayar ve internet teknolojileri ile de uzaktan eğitim yürütülebilmektedir (Alakoç ve Bozbıyık, 2003, s. 1195; Hızal, 1983, s. 69; Koçdar, 2006, s. 31; Unusan ve Abia, 2007, s. 129). Uzaktan eğitimin kullanımı ve uygulanış şekilleri imkânlara, şartlara, ihtiyaçlara göre değişkenlik gösterirken pandemi sürecinde Türkiye’de uzaktan eğitim, televizyon ve internet teknolojileri kullanılarak yürütülmüştür (MEB, 2020).
discourses.translated_txt: Distance education can also be conducted using multimedia such as tape recorders, radio, television, films, and presentations, as well as through computer and internet technologies (Alakoç & Bozbıyık, 2003, p. 1195; Hızal, 1983, p. 69; Koçdar, 2006, p. 31; Unusan & Abia, 2007, p. 129). While the use and implementation methods of distance education vary according to available resources, conditions, and needs, in Turkey during the pandemic period, distance education was carried out using television and internet technologies (Ministry of National Education, 2020).

discourses.source_txt: Özellikle çevrimdışı eğitim için EBA platformu, çevrimiçi eğitim için ise EBA TV ve Zoom canlı ders yazılımı etkin kullanılmaktadır.
discourses.translated_txt: The EBA platform is used effectively, especially for offline education, while EBA TV and the Zoom live lesson software are utilized for online education.

discourses.source_txt: Uzaktan eğitim en genel ve basit tanımı ile öğrenci ve öğretmenlerin fiziksel olarak aynı yerde olmadığı resmi eğitim sürecidir (National Center for Educaation Statistics [NCES], 2008, s. 1). Uzaktan eğitim sürecinde öğrenciler ve öğretmenler fiziksel olarak ayrı ortamlarda, öğretim kaynaklarıyla ve birbirleriyle etkileşimli iletişim teknolojileriyle bağlantı kurarlar (Simonson, Smaldino, Albright ve Zvacek, 2012, s. 10).
discourses.translated_txt: Distance education, in its most general and simplest definition, is a formal educational process in which students and teachers are not physically in the same place (National Center for Education Statistics [NCES], 2008, p. 1). In the distance education process, students and teachers, while in physically separate environments, connect with instructional resources and with each other through interactive communication technologies (Simonson, Smaldino, Albright, and Zvacek, 2012, p. 10).

discourses.source_txt: Uzaktan eğitimin kavramsal olarak yeni eğitim imkânları yaratmak, iş ile öğretimi bütünleştirmek, eğitimde fırsat eşitliğini sağlamak, yaşam boyu öğrenmeyi sağlamak, sürece eğitim teknolojisini entegre etmek, bireysel ve kitlesel eğitim imkânı sunmak, eğitimi etkili, verimli ve uygun maliyetli kılmak gibi amaçları vardır (Alkan, 1998, s. 193; Cavanaugh, 2001; s.75). Ayrıca uzaktan eğitim yaş, hastalık, coğrafi uzaklık, ailevi durumlar, zaman ve para sıkıntısı gibi çeşitli nedenlerle örgün öğretim kurumlarında eğitim- öğretim imkânının bulunamadığı ya da bu imkânın yok olduğu zamanlarda öğrenenlere basılı, görsel-işitsel ve elektronik materyaller kullanılarak eğitim-öğretim imkânı sunan bir eğitim yöntemidir (Demiray, 1999, s. 85).
discourses.translated_txt: Conceptually, distance education aims to create new educational opportunities, integrate work and learning, ensure equal opportunity in education, promote lifelong learning, integrate educational technology into the process, provide opportunities for both individual and mass education, and make education effective, efficient, and cost-effective (Alkan, 1998, p. 193; Cavanaugh, 2001, p. 75). Additionally, distance education is an educational method that offers learning opportunities through printed, audiovisual, and electronic materials to learners at times when educational opportunities in formal education institutions are inaccessible or unavailable due to various reasons such as age, illness, geographical distance, family situations, or constraints of time and money (Demiray, 1999, p. 85).

discourses.source_txt: Her öğretim yöntemi farklı kullanım özelliklerine sahip olup bir yöntem için daima bütün öğrencilere her şartta uygundur, kullanışlıdır, başarılıdır denilemez.
discourses.translated_txt: Each teaching method has different characteristics of use, and it cannot be claimed that any one method is always suitable, practical, or successful for all students under all conditions.

discourses.source_txt:
Bir yöntem seçilirken şartlar, öğrenciler gibi yöntem seçimini etkileyen değişkenler vardır. Bütün yöntemlerin kendi özelinde avantaj ve dezavantajı bulunmakla birlikte uzaktan eğitimin de birçok avantaj ve dezavantajı vardır. Özellikle yüz yüze eğitim ile kıyaslandığında uzaktan eğitimin önemli avantajları göze çarpmaktadır. Uzaktan eğitim zaman ve mekân sınırlaması olmaksızın geniş kitlelere bilgiye erişim imkânı sunar. Eğitim süreçlerine zenginlik ve esneklik de katarak öğrenenlerin sürekli ve bağımsız bir şekilde kendi öğrenme hızında öğrenmelerine olanak verir. Uzaktan eğitim bilgi ve iletişim teknolojileri ile bilgiye anında ve daha kolay ulaşılmasına imkân tanır, eğitim maliyetlerini düşürür, esnek ve objektif bir ölçme değerlendirme sunar (Elitaş, 2017, s. 94; İşman, 2008, s. 18; Uşun, 2006, s. 19). Teknolojinin eğitime yansıması ve beraber kullanılması ile birlikte daha gelişmiş biçimlerde yürütülen uzaktan eğitim elbette ki bazı dezavantajları da beraberinde getirmektedir. dezavantajları şu şekilde açıklamıştır: Grupla çalışma disiplininden yoksun olma durumu ile etkileşim eksikliğinden dolayı motivasyon kaybına ve öğrenenin asosyalleşmesine sebep olabilir. Uygulama gerektiren derslerin veya konuların öğretiminde yetersiz kalabilir. Teknoloji bağımlılığı riski ve ölçme ve değerlendirmenin güvenirliği sorunu olabilir.
discourses.translated_txt: When selecting a method, there are variables such as conditions and students that affect the choice of method. While all methods have their own specific advantages and disadvantages, distance education also has many advantages and disadvantages. Especially when compared to face-to-face education, the significant advantages of distance education become evident. Distance education provides access to information for large groups without limitations of time and place. By adding richness and flexibility to educational processes, it allows learners to learn continuously and independently at their own pace. Distance education enables instant and easier access to information through information and communication technologies, reduces educational costs, and offers flexible and objective assessment and evaluation (Elitaş, 2017, p. 94; İşman, 2008, p. 18; Uşun, 2006, p. 19). Of course, as technology is reflected in education and used in conjunction with it, distance education conducted in more advanced forms also brings some disadvantages. Elitaş (2017, p. 95) explained the important disadvantages of distance education as follows: The lack of a group work discipline and the lack of interaction may lead to loss of motivation and cause the learner to become antisocial. It may be inadequate for teaching courses or topics that require practical application. There may be a risk of technology dependence and problems with the reliability of assessment and evaluation.

discourses.source_txt: Mektupla başlayıp günümüz gelişmiş yazılım ve donanım cihazları ile yapılan uzaktan eğitime kadar uzanan süreçte dünyada uzaktan eğitimin başlangıcı 1700’lü yıllara, ülkemizde ise 1900’lü yıllara dayanmaktadır. Özellikle 1728 yılında Boston Gazetesi’nde steno derslerinin uzaktan eğitim ile verileceğinin duyurulması önemli bir gelişme olarak kaydedilirken 1833 yılında mektuplar kullanılarak öğrenim gerçekleştirileceğinin yayınlandığı bir ilan ile de uzaktan eğitim alanında önemli bir adım atılmıştır (Çoban, 2013, s. 2). Türkiye’de ise eğitim kurumlarının fiziki eksikleri gibi sorunların da olduğu ve eğitimin genel sorunlarına çözüm arandığı bir dönemde 1927 yılında mektupla öğretimin çözüm olarak ele alınması ile uzaktan eğitimin ilk adımları atılmıştır (Arar, 1999, s. 26). 1950’li yıllarda mesleki eğitim ve yabancı dil eğitiminde uzaktan eğitim teşvik edilmiş, 1968’de TRT’nin kurulmasıyla uzaktan eğitimde televizyon teknolojisinden yararlanmak için çalışmalar yürütülmüştür. 1982’de Anadolu Üniversitesi Açık Öğretim Fakültesi resmi olarak hizmet vermeye başlamış, 1990’larda üniversitelerdeki web tabanlı uzaktan eğitim çalışmaları hız kazanmıştır (Çukadar ve Çelik, 2003, s. 33; Fiş Erümit, Gedik ve Göktaş, 2016, s. 666). Son yıllarda ise Kırık’ın (2016, s. 58) da belirttiği gibi uzaktan eğitim Türkiye’de oldukça gelişmiş olup COVID-19 sürecinde de eğitim EBA platformu ve EBA TV ile uzaktan yürütülmüş ardından 2020-2021 eğitim öğretim yılında Zoom gibi ücretsiz uygulamalarla da uzaktan eğitimin desteklenmesine MEB tarafından izin verilmiştir.
discourses.translated_txt: The process of distance education, which began with correspondence courses and extends to the advanced software and hardware technologies used today, dates back to the 1700s globally and to the 1900s in our country. In particular, the announcement in the Boston Gazette in 1728 that shorthand lessons would be delivered via distance education is recorded as a significant development, and the publication in 1833 of an advertisement stating that learning would be conducted using letters marked another important step in the field of distance education (Çoban, 2013, p. 2). In Turkey, the initial steps of distance education were taken in 1927 when correspondence education was considered a solution during a period when educational institutions faced physical deficiencies and solutions were sought for general educational problems (Arar, 1999, p. 26). In the 1950s, distance education was encouraged in vocational and foreign language training, and with the establishment of TRT in 1968, efforts were made to utilize television technology in distance education. In 1982, the Open Education Faculty of Anadolu University officially began its services, and in the 1990s, web-based distance education initiatives gained momentum in universities (Çukadar & Çelik, 2003, p. 33; Fiş Erümit, Gedik & Göktaş, 2016, p. 666). In recent years, as Kırık (2016, p. 58) has also noted, distance education has become highly developed in Turkey, and during the COVID-19 period, education was conducted remotely through the EBA platform and EBA TV. Subsequently, in the 2020-2021 academic year, the Ministry of National Education allowed the use of free applications such as Zoom to further support distance education.

discourses.source_txt:
Araştırmanın Önemi ve Amacı
COVID-19 salgınının yayılmasını yavaşlatmak amacıyla zaman zaman ülke yönetimleri sokağa çıkma, seyahat yapma gibi birçok konuda kısıtlamaya giderken eğitim öğretim kurumlarının kapatılması da alınan önlemler arasına eklenmiştir. Bu süreçte öğrenenlerin eğitiminin sürekliliğini sağlamak ve ülkelerin eğitim sistemini canlı tutmak için uzaktan eğitim sistemi ile süreç yeniden yapılandırılmıştır. Öğrencilerin merkezde yer aldığı uzaktan eğitim sisteminde öğrenciler için uygun öğrenme ortamları oluşturan öğretmenin rolü özellikle bütün dünyayı etkisi altına alan bu salgın döneminde daha da önem kazanmaktadır. Uzaktan eğitimde öğrenme süreçlerini kolaylaştırma ve öğrenciye rehberlik etme rolleri de olan öğretmenlerin uzaktan eğitime yönelik bakış açıları ve uzaktan eğitimle ders verme deneyimleri gibi özellikleri eğitim öğretim sürecinin verimliliğini etkilemektedir (Harris ve Krousgill, 2008, s. 918; Yurdakul, 2015).
discourses.translated_txt:
Importance and Purpose of the Study  
In order to slow the spread of the COVID-19 pandemic, governments at times implemented various restrictions such as curfews and travel bans, and the closure of educational institutions was also among the measures taken. During this period, the educational process was restructured through the distance education system to ensure the continuity of learning for students and to keep the countries’ educational systems active. In the distance education system, where students are at the center, the role of the teacher in creating suitable learning environments for students has become even more significant, especially during this pandemic, which affected the entire world. Teacher roles in facilitating learning processes and guiding students in distance education, as well as their perspectives on distance education and their experiences teaching through this method, are factors that affect the efficiency of the educational process (Harris & Krousgill, 2008, p. 918; Yurdakul, 2015).

discourses.translated_txt: In Turkey, during the pandemic period, distance education was implemented as of 16/03/2020, and many teachers had to conduct the distance education process, with which they were not as familiar as face-to-face education (Ministry of National Education, 2020).

discourses.source_txt: Bu noktada ise öğretmenlerin uzaktan eğitime yönelik bakış açılarının belirlenmesi ve elde edilen bulgular doğrultusunda öneriler geliştirilmesi uzaktan eğitim sürecinin etkili ve verimli yürütülebilmesi için önem arz etmektedir. Ayrıca bu araştırmanın çalışma grubu, yöntem ve küresel olarak içinde bulunduğumuz özel süreçte yürütülen eğitim öğretim faaliyetlerinin değerlendirilmesi bakımından özgün olduğu düşünülmektedir.
discourses.translated_txt: At this point, identifying teachers’ perspectives on distance education and developing recommendations based on the findings are important for conducting the distance education process effectively and efficiently. Additionally, the study group and method of this research, as well as its evaluation of educational activities conducted during the unique global circumstances we are experiencing, are considered original.

discourses.source_txt: Nitekim literatürde; COVID-19 sürecinde yapılmış olan uzaktan eğitim çalışmalarının da tıpkı pandemi öncesi süreçte olduğu gibi daha çok nicel çalışma temelinde ve deneysel desende yürütüldüğü, nitel veya karma desenli çalışmaların daha az olduğu görülmektedir.
discourses.translated_txt: Indeed, the literature shows that, just like in the pre-pandemic period, distance education studies conducted during the COVID-19 process have mostly been based on quantitative research and experimental designs, while qualitative or mixed-method studies are less common.

discourses.source_txt: Bu çalışmada ise nitel veri toplama tekniklerinden görüşme tekniği kullanılarak daha derinlemesine veriler elde edilmesi amaçlanmıştır.
discourses.translated_txt: In this study, the interview technique, one of the qualitative data collection methods, was used in order to obtain more in-depth data.

discourses.source_txt: Ayrıca alanyazında öğrencilerin, öğretmenlerin ve öğretim elemanlarının uzaktan eğitime yönelik görüş veya tutumlarının belirlenmesine yönelik çalışmaların yapıldığı görülmekle birlikte bu çalışmalar daha çok özellikle lisans ve üstü düzeydeki öğrenciler temele alınarak yapılmıştır (Aktaş, Büyüktaş, Gülle ve Yıldız, 2020, s. 3; Alper ve Deryakulu, 2008, s. 53; Çakır Balta ve Horzum, 2008, s. 191-192; Horzum, Özkaya, Demirci ve Alpaslan, 2013, s. 85; Karadağ ve Yücel, 2020, s. 183; Keskin ve Özer Kaya, 2020, s. 59; Pınar ve Dönel, 2020, s. 462; Türker ve Yaylak, 2011, s. 154).
discourses.translated_txt: In addition, although studies have been conducted in the literature to determine the views or attitudes of students, teachers, and faculty members toward distance education, it is observed that these studies have mainly focused on students at the undergraduate and higher levels (Aktaş, Büyüktaş, Gülle & Yıldız, 2020, p. 3; Alper & Deryakulu, 2008, p. 53; Çakır Balta & Horzum, 2008, pp. 191-192; Horzum, Özkaya, Demirci & Alpaslan, 2013, p. 85; Karadağ & Yücel, 2020, p. 183; Keskin & Özer Kaya, 2020, p. 59; Pınar & Dönel, 2020, p. 462; Türker & Yaylak, 2011, p. 154).

discourses.source_txt: Bu çalışmada ise eğitim sürecinin uygulayıcısı olan öğretmenlerle çalışma yürütülmüş olup alan yazında bu açıdan da katkı sağlayacağı düşünülmektedir.
discourses.translated_txt: In this study, research was conducted with teachers, who are the practitioners of the educational process, and it is believed that this will contribute to the literature from this perspective as well.

discourses.source_txt:
Bu çalışmanın amacı Türkiye’de COVID-19 nedeniyle mecburi yürütülen uzaktan eğitime yönelik öğretmen görüşlerini belirlemek ve bunlardan hareketle uzaktan eğitim sürecinin verimliliğini artırmaya yönelik önerilerde bulunmaktır. Araştırmanın problem cümlesi ise “Türkiye’de COVID-19 nedeniyle mecburi yürütülen uzaktan eğitime yönelik öğretmen görüşleri nelerdir?” olarak ifade edilmiş olup yanıt aranan alt problemler şunlardır:
1) Uzaktan eğitimle yürütülen derslerin verilme durumları ve öğrenme
süreçlerine etkisi hakkında öğretmen görüşleri nelerdir? 2) Uzaktan eğitimde değerlendirme süreçlerine dair öğretmen görüşleri nelerdir? 3) Uzaktan eğitimle dersleri yürütmede öğretmenlerin kendilerini
yeterli görme durumları (hizmetiçi eğitim ihtiyaçları) hakkında görüşleri nelerdir? 4) Yüz yüze eğitim ile karşılaştırıldığında uzaktan eğitimin olumluolumsuz yönleri nelerdir? 5) Uzaktan eğitim sürecinin etkili ve verimli yürütülebilmesine dair
öğretmenlerin önerileri nelerdir?
discourses.translated_txt:
The aim of this study is to determine teachers’ opinions regarding the compulsory implementation of distance education in Turkey due to COVID-19 and, based on these opinions, to offer suggestions for increasing the effectiveness of the distance education process. The research problem is stated as follows: “What are teachers’ opinions on the compulsory distance education implemented in Turkey due to COVID-19?” The following sub-problems are addressed:
1) What are teachers’ opinions regarding the delivery of courses conducted through distance education and their impact on learning processes? 2) What are teachers’ views on assessment processes in distance education? 3) What are teachers’ perspectives on their self-perceived competence (needs for in-service training) in conducting courses via distance education? 4) Compared to face-to-face education, what are the positive and negative aspects of distance education? 5) What are teachers’ suggestions for the effective and efficient implementation of the distance education process?

Bu özel süreçte mevcut imkânlarla yürütülen uzaktan eğitimi öğretmenlerin bakış açılarıyla değerlendirmek, sonraki süreçlerde yürütülecek uzaktan

discourses.translated_txt: Evaluating distance education conducted with the available means during this unique period from the perspectives of teachers may provide a basis for improving, conducting more efficiently, and addressing the deficiencies of distance education activities to be carried out in subsequent periods.

discourses.source_txt: Nitekim MEB tarafından yapılan açıklamada pandemi süreci sonrasında da yüz yüze eğitimin uzaktan eğitim ile beraber yürütüleceği, uzaktan eğitimden tamamen vazgeçilmeyeceği ifade edilmiş olup 2020-2021 eğitim öğretim yılında da uygulanmaya başlanmıştır. COVID-19 sürecinde uzaktan eğitime katılan öğretmenler bu sürecin uygulayıcıları olması dolayısıyla eğitim sürecini daha verimli geçirebilmek adına öğretmenlerin görüşlerine önem verilmeli, tespitleri ve önerileri dikkate alınmalıdır. Bu çalışmanın sonuçlarının uzaktan eğitim süreçlerinin düzenlenmesi ve yeniden yapılandırılması bakımından karar vericilere, MEB’e ve öğretmenlere, bu sonuçlar doğrultusunda atılacak adımlar dolayısıyla da öğrencilere faydalı olacağı ve yol gösterebileceği düşünülmektedir. Bu çalışmanın COVID-19 sürecinde alanyazında eğitim sürecinin uygulayıcısı olan öğretmenlerle yeterli sayıda ve derinlemesine bilgi elde edememe konusundaki eksikliği gidermeye katkı sağlayacağı düşünülmektedir. Araştırma sonuçlarının diğer araştırmacılara uzaktan eğitime yönelik öğretmen görüşlerinin farklı boyutlardan ele alınmasına dair yol gösterebileceği düşünülmektedir.
discourses.translated_txt: Indeed, in the statement made by the Ministry of National Education (MEB), it was indicated that after the pandemic period, face-to-face education would be conducted alongside distance education and that distance education would not be completely abandoned. This approach was implemented in the 2020-2021 academic year as well. Since teachers participating in distance education during the COVID-19 period are the practitioners of this process, their opinions should be valued to make the educational process more effective, and their observations and suggestions should be taken into consideration. It is believed that the results of this study will be beneficial and provide guidance for decision-makers, the Ministry of National Education, and teachers in the organization and restructuring of distance education processes, and that steps taken accordingly will benefit students as well. Furthermore, it is thought that this study will help address the gap in the literature regarding the inability to obtain sufficient and in-depth information from teachers, who are the practitioners of the educational process during the COVID-19 period. The research findings are also expected to guide other researchers on how to address teachers’ opinions on distance education from different perspectives.

discourses.source_txt:
Yöntem
Araştırma Modeli
Araştırma olgubilim (fenomenoloji) modelindedir. Eğitim araştırmalarında bir fenomeni açıklamak, buna bağlı olarak yaşam deneyimlerini açıklamaya çalışmak, sonuçları, değişkenleri değerlendirmek yaygın bir kullanımdır. Bu doğrultuda insanların yaşam durumları hakkında derinlemesine bilgi elde etmek için küçük gruplarla nitel çalışmalar yapılır (Arthur, Waring, Robert ve Hedges, 2017, s. 10-11). Kişi ya da kişilerin bir olguya ilişkin yaşadıkları deneyim olarak nitelendirilen olgubilim çalışmalarında deneyimlemenin önemli olduğu bilinmektedir (Seggie ve Bayyurt, 2017, s. 3). Araştırmada COVID-19 sürecinde mecburi yürütülen uzaktan eğitimi deneyimleyen öğretmenler ile görüşülerek bu süreçte gerçekleşen durumlar, eksikler, avantajlar, dezavantajlar, öğrenci ve öğretmene yansımalar açıklanmaya çalışılmıştır. Burada asıl amaç genellemelere ulaşmaktan ziyade bahsedilen durumu betimlemek, keşfetmektir.
discourses.translated_txt:
Method
Research Model
The research employs the phenomenological model. In educational research, explaining a phenomenon, thereby attempting to clarify life experiences related to it and evaluating results and variables, is a common practice. Accordingly, qualitative studies are conducted with small groups to obtain in-depth information about people's life situations (Arthur, Waring, Robert, and Hedges, 2017, pp. 10-11). In phenomenological studies, which are defined as the experience of an event or phenomenon by an individual or individuals, it is known that experiencing the phenomenon is of critical importance (Seggie and Bayyurt, 2017, p. 3). In this study, interviews were conducted with teachers who experienced the distance education that was mandatorily implemented during the COVID-19 period, and the situations, deficiencies, advantages, disadvantages, and reflections on students and teachers that occurred during this process were examined. The main purpose here is not to reach generalizations, but rather to describe and explore the situation in question.

discourses.source_txt: Nitekim nitel araştırmalar da bunu gerektirmektedir (Sönmez ve Alacapınar, 2013, s. 70).
discourses.translated_txt: Indeed, qualitative research also necessitates this (Sönmez and Alacapınar, 2013, p. 70).

discourses.source_txt: Görüşme yapılan öğretmenler amaçlı çalışma gruplarından tipik durum çalışma grubu yöntemine göre seçilmiştir. Bu yöntemde temsil edici özelliği olanların çalışma grubuna dâhil edildiği ifade edilmektedir (Sönmez ve Alacapınar, 2013, s. 97-98). Görüşülenlerin, bu süreçte uzaktan eğitime aktif katılan öğretmenler olması ve çalışma grubu içinde hem teorik hem uygulamalı branşlara sahip öğretmenler olması çalışma grubuna dâhil olmada tipik durum olarak düşünülmüştür. Araştırma öncesinde öğretmenler, araştırma ve görüşme hakkında bilgilendirilmiş, görüşme için gönüllülük esasına göre hareket edilmiştir. Farklı branşlarda öğretmenlerin katılımcı olması ve derslerin konu içeriklerinin teorik ve uygulamalı anlatımları içeren dersler olması, araştırmanın amacına ulaşmasında yarar sağlayacağı düşünülmüştür. Öğretmenler aktif olarak bahsedilen uzaktan eğitim sürecinde görev yapmışlardır.
discourses.translated_txt: The teachers interviewed were selected according to the typical case sampling method, which is a form of purposive sampling. In this method, individuals who possess representative characteristics are included in the study group (Sönmez and Alacapınar, 2013, pp. 97-98). The fact that the interviewees were teachers who actively participated in distance education during this process, and that the study group included teachers from both theoretical and applied branches, was considered as a typical case in forming the study group. Prior to the research, the teachers were informed about the study and the interviews, and participation was voluntary. The inclusion of teachers from different branches and the fact that the course content covered both theoretical and practical aspects were considered beneficial for achieving the aims of the study. The teachers actively served during the aforementioned distance education process.

discourses.source_txt: Araştırmanın yürütülebilmesi için gerekli etik kurul izni alınmıştır.
discourses.translated_txt: The necessary ethics committee approval for conducting the research was obtained.

discourses.source_txt:
Geçerlik ve Güvenirlik
Nitel çalışmalarda geçerlik ve güvenirlik nicel çalışmalara göre oldukça farklılaşmıştır. Nitel çalışmalarda araştırmanın başından sonuna kadar işlemleri açıklamak, sonuçları detaylı raporlamak, objektif, esnek ve şeffaf olmak geçerlik ve güvenirlik ölçütü olarak ifade edilmektedir (Yıldırım ve Şimşek, 2008). Kuş (2008) da nitel çalışmalarda bilgisayar destekli yazılım kullanımının şeffaflığı ve genellenebilirliği artırarak geçerlik ve güvenirliği artırmaya katkıda bulunduğunu ifade etmektedir. Araştırma boyunca yapılan işlemler, aşamalar detaylıca açıklanmaya çalışılmış, veri toplama aracı geliştirme sürecinde uzman görüşü alınmıştır.
discourses.translated_txt:
Validity and Reliability  
Validity and reliability in qualitative studies differ significantly from those in quantitative studies. In qualitative research, explaining the procedures from the beginning to the end of the study, reporting the results in detail, and being objective, flexible, and transparent are considered criteria for validity and reliability (Yıldırım & Şimşek, 2008). Kuş (2008) also states that the use of computer-assisted software in qualitative studies contributes to enhancing validity and reliability by increasing transparency and generalizability. Throughout the research, the procedures and stages were explained in detail, and expert opinions were sought during the development of the data collection tool.

discourses.source_txt:

Fatih BALAMAN & Sevil HANBAY TİRYAKİ
yazılımı da kullanılarak derinlemesine analiz edilip doğrudan alıntılara sıkça yer verilmiş, geçerlik sağlanmaya çalışılmıştır. İç güvenirlik için kodlayıcılar arası görüş birliği hesaplanmıştır. Hesaplamada Miles ve Huberman (1994, s. 64)’ ın nitel çalışmalar için kullanılan güvenirlik katsayısı formülü (güvenirlik = görüş birliği / (görüş birliği + görüş ayrılığı)x100) kullanılmıştır. Miles ve Huberman (1994, s. 64) formüle göre güvenirliğin en az %70 olmasını önermektedir. Araştırmada yazılı metin halindeki görüşme verileri araştırmacılar tarafından ayrı ayrı kodlanmış, kodlamalar incelenerek görüş birliği ve görüş ayrılığı olan kodlamalar belirlenmiştir. Elde edilen sonuçlarla kodlayıcılar arası görüş birliği %83.75 olarak hesaplanmıştır. Dış güvenirlik için katılımcıların özelliklerinin tanımlanması, sınırlılıkların ifade edilmesi, veri toplama süreci ve analizlerden bahsedilmesi gerekmektedir (Yıldırım ve Şimşek, 2013). Bu gereklilikler araştırmada uygun başlıklar altında açıklanmış, dış güvenirlik sağlanmaya çalışılmıştır. Verilerin Toplanması ve Veri Toplama Aracı
Veriler nitel veri toplama yöntemlerinden görüşme yöntemi ile sanal ortamda çevrimdışı olarak, yarı yapılandırılmış görüşme formu kullanılarak toplanmıştır. Görüşmeler yazılı olarak gerçekleştirilmiştir.
discourses.translated_txt: The data were subjected to in-depth analysis using qualitative data analysis software, with frequent inclusion of direct quotations in an effort to ensure validity. For internal reliability, inter-coder agreement was calculated. In this calculation, the reliability coefficient formula for qualitative studies proposed by Miles and Huberman (1994, p. 64) was used (reliability = agreement / (agreement + disagreement) x 100). According to Miles and Huberman (1994, p. 64), a minimum reliability of 70% is recommended. In this study, the interview data in written form were coded independently by the researchers, and the codes were reviewed to identify areas of agreement and disagreement. As a result, the inter-coder agreement was calculated to be 83.75%. For external reliability, it is necessary to describe the characteristics of the participants, state the limitations, and discuss the data collection process and analyses (Yıldırım & Şimşek, 2013). These requirements were explained under appropriate headings in the study, and an effort was made to ensure external reliability. Data Collection and Data Collection Tool The data were collected offline in a virtual environment using the interview method—one of the qualitative data collection methods—through a semi-structured interview form. The interviews were conducted in written form.

discourses.source_txt: İletişimin yüz yüze olmamasında mevcut COVID-19 süreci, çevrimdışı olmasında ise görüşülenlerin tercihleri etkili olmuştur. Nitekim Seggie ve Bayyurt (2017, s. 44) da görüşme verilerinin yüz yüze toplanabileceği gibi telefonla veya internet yoluyla yazılı veya görüntülü olarak da elde edilebileceğini ifade etmektedir. Görüşme formu hazırlanmadan önce konu ile ilgili kaynak taraması yapılmış, görüşme sorularının oluşturulmasına yönelik hazırlık yapılmıştır. Görüşme öncesinde, öğretmenlere verilerin sadece bilimsel amaçlı kullanılacağı konusunda güvence verilmiş, ilgili kurumdan resmi iznin alındığı kendilerine iletilmiştir.
discourses.translated_txt: The current COVID-19 situation was influential in the lack of face-to-face communication, while the interviewees’ preferences played a role in the communication being offline. Indeed, Seggie and Bayyurt (2017, p. 44) also state that interview data can be collected face-to-face, or obtained in written or visual form via telephone or the internet. Before preparing the interview form, a literature review on the subject was conducted, and preparations were made for the development of the interview questions. Prior to the interviews, teachers were assured that the data would be used solely for scientific purposes, and they were informed that official permission had been obtained from the relevant institution.

discourses.source_txt: Yarı yapılandırılmış görüşme yöntemi ile veri toplamak, olgubilim araştırmalarında en sık tercih edilen veri toplama yöntemidir. Elde edilen veriler görüşülenlerin hikâyesine bağlı kalınarak anlatıma dönüştürülür.
discourses.translated_txt: Collecting data through the semi-structured interview method is the most commonly preferred data collection method in phenomenological research. The data obtained are transformed into narrative form by adhering to the story of the interviewees.

discourses.source_txt: Olgubilimde yorumlamak çok önemli olup bu yöntem, yorumlayıcı olgubilim araştırmaları olarak da anılmaktadır (Seggie ve Bayyurt, 2017, s. 72).
discourses.translated_txt: Interpretation is highly significant in phenomenology, and this method is also referred to as interpretive phenomenological research (Seggie and Bayyurt, 2017, p. 72).

discourses.source_txt: Görüşme soruları başlangıçta 11 soru olarak oluşturulmuştu.
discourses.translated_txt: The interview questions were initially formulated as 11 questions.

discourses.source_txt: Hazırlanan bu form eğitim fakültesinde Eğitim Bilimleri ile Bilgisayar ve Öğretim Teknolojileri Eğitimi bölümlerinden 5 öğretim elemanına kapsam geçerliğini sağlamak amacıyla gönderilmiştir. Öğretim elemanlarından; soruların araştırma konusunu kapsama ve araştırma gereksinimlerini karşılama durumları bakımından incelemeleri istenmiştir. Geri bildirimler sonrasında 1 soru çıkarılmış, 2 soru da başka sorularla birleştirilerek sorulmasına karar verilmiş ve görüşme formunun son hali 8 sorudan oluşmuştur.
discourses.translated_txt: This form was sent to five faculty members from the Departments of Educational Sciences and Computer Education and Instructional Technology at the Faculty of Education to ensure content validity. The faculty members were asked to review the questions in terms of how well they covered the research topic and met the research requirements. Following the feedback, one question was removed and two questions were merged with others, resulting in a final interview form consisting of eight questions.

The aim was to identify the effects of these systems on the learning process, as well as to reveal teachers’ observations regarding the effects of distance education and these systems on students, teachers, and learning itself. The data were collected in the final weeks of the second semester of the 2019-2020 academic year.

discourses.source_txt:
Verilerin Analizi
Verilerin çözümlenmesinde içerik analizi yöntemi kullanılmıştır. İçerik analizinde nitel veriler derinlemesine çözümlenerek kodlamalar yapılır, kodlamalara bağlı olarak temalar oluşturulur, temalara ilişkin maddelerde frekans ve yüzde değerlerine yer verilir (Sönmez ve Alacapınar, 2013, s. 116). Veriler analiz edilirken Nitel Veri Analiz Programı olan NVivo 10 yazılımından da yararlanılmıştır. Özellikle kodlamalarda, kodlamaların bir araya getirilerek temaların oluşturulmasında, sık geçen kelimelerin tespitinde, model oluşturmada ve diğer sorgulamalarda NVivo 10 kullanılmıştır.
discourses.translated_txt:
Data Analysis  
The content analysis method was used to analyze the data. In content analysis, qualitative data are analyzed in depth and coded; based on these codes, themes are generated, and the items related to these themes are reported with their frequency and percentage values (Sönmez and Alacapınar, 2013, p. 116). During the data analysis, the NVivo 10 software, a qualitative data analysis program, was also utilized. NVivo 10 was specifically employed for coding, generating themes by merging codes, identifying frequently occurring words, constructing models, and conducting other queries.

Findings  
As a result of the content analysis, the following themes emerged based on the teachers’ responses: “situations encountered specifically during the COVID-19 period,” “conveniences provided by distance education,” “disadvantages encountered in distance education,” and “needs felt throughout the process.” Each theme and its subthemes were modeled and presented in NVivo along with their frequencies.

Teachers stated that their current level of knowledge and skills in using distance education systems was insufficient and, accordingly, there was a need for training; that distance education alone was not sufficient to instill the target behaviors; that there were students in need of computers and internet access; that there were problems accessing servers; and that there was a need for a secure live lesson platform.

Uzaktan eğitimde etkileşimin farklılaşmış olması duyguların yansıtılmasını sınırlandırmaktadır. Gerek uzaktan eğitimin sistemsel özellikleri gerek sınıf içindeki sinerjinin olmayışı bunun sebepleri arasındadır. Öğrenme bir iletişim sürecidir ve bu süreçte duyguları ifade etmek önemlidir. Etkili iletişim ile öğrenme düzeyi ve sosyal ilişkiler güçlenebilir. İletişimin unsurlarından biri de geri bildirimdir. Uzaktan eğitimde belli düzeyde geri bildirim yapılabilirken bu geri bildirimlerin yüz yüze ortamdaki gibi etkili değildir. Öğrencilerin ve öğretmenin sanal ortamında birbirini görmüyor olması öğrenmenin kontrolünü daha çok öğrenciye bırakmakta, öğrenmeye yönelik dış uyarıcıları azaltmaktadır. Dolayısıyla öğrencilerin öğrenmeye yönelik motivasyonu düşebilmektedir.

Volume: 10,
“Journal of the Human and Social Sciences Researches”
Issue: 1,

Fatih BALAMAN & Sevil HANBAY TİRYAKİ
The differentiation of interaction in distance education restricts the expression of emotions. Both the systemic characteristics of distance education and the lack of synergy found in the classroom are among the reasons for this. Learning is a communication process, and expressing emotions is important in this process. Through effective communication, the level of learning and social relationships can be strengthened. One of the components of communication is feedback. Although some level of feedback can be provided in distance education, this feedback is not as effective as in face-to-face environments. The fact that students and teachers do not see each other in the virtual environment leaves the control of learning more to the student and reduces external stimuli related to learning. Therefore, students’ motivation towards learning may decrease.

Findings Related to the Question: “Do You Think Teachers Need In-Service Training While Managing the Distance Education Process (if so, on which subjects)?”
The use of systems such as Zoom, EBA TV, and the offline EBA platform by students and especially teachers requires a certain level of computer and internet literacy. If we include content preparation in this usage, the scope will become even broader. Interviews revealed that some struggled with using the systems and that most considered in-service training necessary. While there was general consensus on the need for in-service training, it was also found that the Ministry of National Education actually has educational videos on this topic for system usage. Teacher statements on this subject were as follows. Tchr.1: “I definitely think there is a need for in-service training. First of all, every educator should primarily receive training in basic computer usage and auxiliary programs, Office programs, lesson and content development, video and audio editing, and Web 2.0 tools.”
Tchr.3: “If there are going to be new applications (involving technical knowledge), in-service training can be provided.”

Ancak yüz yüze eğitimin yapılamadığı COVID-19 döneminde eğitim – öğretimin aksamaması için yüz yüze eğitime en yakın olan, yüz yüze ortamda yapılabilecekleri sanal ortamda mümkün mertebe sağlayabilen de yine uzaktan eğitimdir. Bu açıdan yüz yüze eğitimi tam olarak karşılamasa da öğretmenler yüz yüze eğitime en iyi alternatifin, çözümün uzaktan eğitim olabileceğinden bahsetmişlerdir. Genelde uzaktan eğitimin en büyük avantajlarından biri olan zaman ve mekândan bağımsızlık bu süreçte de hissedilmiştir. Bunun dışında çevrimdışı dersleri öğrenciler diledikleri kadar tekrar ederek öğrenebildiği uzaktan eğitimde öğretmenler özellikle videoların durdur – devam et imkânına dikkat çekmişlerdir.

Findings Regarding the Question: “Can You Compare Distance Education and Traditional Education in Terms of Advantages and Disadvantages?”
Teachers generally mentioned both the advantages and disadvantages of distance education when compared to face-to-face teaching. However, during the COVID-19 period, when face-to-face education could not be conducted, the next best alternative that could most closely approximate what could be done in a face-to-face environment and ensure the continuity of teaching was, again, distance education. In this respect, although it does not fully replace face-to-face education, teachers stated that the best alternative or solution to face-to-face instruction could be distance education. One of the most significant advantages of distance education, namely independence from time and place, was also felt during this period. In addition, teachers especially emphasized the opportunity in distance education for students to rewatch offline lessons as many times as they wish, particularly highlighting the pause–resume feature of videos.

It was unforeseeable that the unexpectedly developing COVID-19 process would affect human life and daily activities to this extent. Many activities in human life either stopped entirely or were carried on through alternative methods in safer ways. The education–teaching activity, which holds vital importance in our lives, was also continued through distance education since in-person instruction was no longer possible. It was a significant advantage that, prior to this process, our Ministry had already undertaken important work related to distance education and had made practices actively available for use by students and teachers. The transition from face-to-face education to distance learning in teaching brought about many adjustments for both teachers and students. It is understood that the Ministry, making considerable efforts to ensure efficiency in education and teaching, implemented important practices during this period. On this subject, teachers shared the following views.

Kelime bulutlarında yazı boyutu büyüdükçe görüşme verilerinde bahsedilen kelimenin sıklığının arttığı bilinmektedir. Böylece öne çıkan kavramlar, vurgulanan ifadeler görselleştirilebilmektedir.

Word Cloud and Word Tree Generated with NVivo 10
A word cloud can be generated with NVivo to identify the most frequently mentioned words and to extract the concepts that are heavily emphasized. It is known that as the font size increases in word clouds, the frequency of the mentioned word in the interview data also rises. In this way, prominent concepts and highlighted expressions can be visualized.

According to the word cloud obtained in the study, words such as distance education, course, students, and EBA were frequently mentioned in the interviews.

kelime ağacı oluşturulmuştur. Frekansı en yüksek olan uzaktan eğitim kavramının en sık geçen ifade olduğu anlaşılmıştı. Bu kavram etrafında oluşan kelime ağacına göre uzaktan eğitim ile beraber kullanılan kelime grupları görselleştirilmiştir. Görselin okunabilirliğini artırmak amacıyla kelime ağacı iki bölüm halinde sunulmuştur. Şekil 2: Uzaktan Eğitim Kelime Ağacı -1
Uzaktan eğitimin kurtarıcı olarak görülmesi, bu süreçte ailelere de görevler düştüğü, öğrencinin aktif olması durumunun uzaktan eğitimde sınırlı kaldığı, bakanlığın virüs sürecinde hızlı harekete geçtiği sonuçları kelime ağacının bu bölümünde elde edilen sonuçlardan bazılarıdır.
discourses.translated_txt: With the extraction of preliminary statements related to qualitative data from the word cloud, in order to obtain information such as the locations of these statements within written texts and their sequences with other concepts, and to examine their relationships, a word tree was created. It was found that the most frequently occurring concept was "distance education." According to the word tree generated around this concept, word groups commonly used together with distance education were visualized. To enhance the readability of the visual, the word tree was presented in two sections. Figure 2: Distance Education Word Tree -1 Some of the findings obtained from this section of the word tree include the perception of distance education as a savior, the responsibilities assigned to families during this process, the limited activeness of students in distance education, and the Ministry's rapid action during the virus period.

Bu zorunlu süreçte uzaktan eğitimin en iyi alternatif olması, müzik dersi gibi uyuglamalı derslerde yöntemin eksik kalması, uzaktan eğitimi kullanmada öğretmenlerin hizmet içi eğitim alması, uzaktan eğitim için altyapı yeterliliği de kelime ağacının bu bölüm için elde edilen bazı sonuçlarıdır.

Teachers’ Opinions on Compulsory Distance Education Implemented Due to the Coronavirus (Covid-19)

Some of the findings obtained from the word tree for this section are that distance education was considered the best alternative during this compulsory period, the method was insufficient for practice-based courses such as music, teachers received in-service training to use distance education, and the adequacy of the infrastructure for distance education.

discourses.source_txt:
Tartışma ve Sonuç
Derslerin zorunlu olarak dijital ortamlarda yürütülmesinin farklı açılardan yansımaları olmuştur. Öğretmenler arasında her ne kadar uzaktan eğitimin, sınıf ortamında yürütülen yüz yüze eğitimin yerini alamayacağı görüşü hâkimse de yüz yüze eğitim imkânının olmadığı bu olağanüstü süreçte en iyi çözünüm yine uzaktan eğitim olduğu bilinmektedir. Sindiani (2020) de araştırmasında bu süreçte uzaktan eğitimi en iyi seçenek olarak bildirmiştir.
discourses.translated_txt:
Discussion and Conclusion  
The compulsory conduct of courses in digital environments has had various repercussions from different perspectives. Although the dominant opinion among teachers is that distance education cannot replace face-to-face education conducted in classroom settings, it is acknowledged that in this extraordinary period where in-person education is not possible, the best solution remains distance education. Sindiani (2020) also stated in his study that distance education was the best option during this process.

discourses.source_txt: Süreçten bütün paydaşlar farklı şekillerde etkilenirken, öğrencilerin yüz yüze eğitimden ayrı kaldığı COVID-19 sürecinde ciddi seviyede depresyona girdikleri ve yalnızlık hissine kapıldıkları (Lee, Ward, Chang ve Downing, 2020), mutluluk düzeylerinin ve fiziksel aktivitelerinin azaldığı (Munasinghe vd., 2020) araştırmalarda ortaya koyulmuştur. Bu nedenle uzaktan eğitimin kullanılabilirliğini, etkililiğini artırmak için öğrencilerin motivasyonları ve memnuniyet düzeyleri üst seviyelere çıkarılmalı, gereksinimleri mümkün olduğunca karşılanmalıdır.
discourses.translated_txt: While all stakeholders were affected by the process in different ways, studies have shown that during the COVID-19 period, when students were separated from face-to-face education, they experienced significant levels of depression and feelings of loneliness (Lee, Ward, Chang, and Downing, 2020), as well as decreased levels of happiness and physical activity (Munasinghe et al., 2020). For this reason, in order to increase the usability and effectiveness of distance education, students’ motivation and satisfaction levels should be maximized, and their needs should be met as much as possible.

discourses.source_txt: Nitekim Patricia (2020) motivasyon, öz yeterlik ve teknoloji kullanımının öğrencilerin akademik performanslarında önemli rol oynadığını ifade etmektedir.
discourses.translated_txt: Indeed, Patricia (2020) states that motivation, self-efficacy, and the use of technology play a significant role in students' academic performance.

discourses.source_txt: Öğretmenler uzaktan eğitimi yeterli ve tam bir öğretim yöntemi olarak değil, öğrencilerin dersten uzak kalmamaları, eğitim ortamından soğumamaları, tatil havasına girmemeleri gibi çeşitli sebepler için bir araç olarak görmektedirler.
discourses.translated_txt: Teachers perceive distance education not as an adequate and complete instructional method, but rather as a tool for various reasons such as preventing students from falling behind in their lessons, keeping them engaged with the educational environment, and avoiding a holiday mindset.

discourses.source_txt: Kürtüncü ve Kurt (2020, s. 71) da öğretim faaliyetlerinin yüz yüze yapılamamasından öğrencilerin memnun olmadıklarını tespit etmişlerdir.
discourses.translated_txt: Kürtüncü and Kurt (2020, p. 71) also found that students were dissatisfied with not being able to conduct instructional activities face-to-face.

discourses.source_txt: Patricia (2020) ve Sindiani (2020) de araştırmalarında COVID-19 sürecinde öğrencilerin uzaktan eğitim yerine yüz yüze eğitimi tercih ettiklerini ifade etmiştir.
discourses.translated_txt: Patricia (2020) and Sindiani (2020) also stated in their studies that during the COVID-19 period, students preferred face-to-face education over distance education.

discourses.source_txt: Bunların aksine Qazi vd.
discourses.translated_txt: In contrast, Qazi et al.

discourses.source_txt: (2020) ise uzaktan eğitime katılabilen öğrencilerin yöntemden memnuniyetlerini ifade etmiştir.
discourses.translated_txt: In contrast, (2020) reported that students who were able to participate in remote education expressed satisfaction with the method.

discourses.source_txt: Uzaktan eğitim ile bütün öğrencilere ulaşmak, bütün paydaşların yararlanmalarını sağlamak için kırsal kesimlere kadar yeterli teknik alt yapıların sunulması, yazılım ve donanım bakımından erişilebilirliğin mümkün hale getirilmesi gerekmektedir.
discourses.translated_txt: In order to reach all students through remote education and ensure that all stakeholders benefit, it is necessary to provide adequate technical infrastructure even in rural areas and to make accessibility possible in terms of both software and hardware.

discourses.source_txt: Morgan (2020) ile Carrillo ve Flores (2020) de evinde bilgisayar-internet olmayan öğrencilerde yüz yüze eğitime göre gerileme olduğunu tespit etmiştir.
discourses.translated_txt: Morgan (2020) and Carrillo and Flores (2020) also found that students without a computer or internet access at home experienced a decline compared to face-to-face education.

discourses.source_txt:
Bu imkânlara erişimde internet hizmetlerinin ulaştırılması ve ailelerin sosyo-ekonomik durumları etkilidir. İmkânlar bakımından öğrenciler arasındaki farklılık fırsat eşitsizliğini de doğurmaktadır (Bennett, Uink ve Cross, 2020). Nitekim ülkemizde pandemi sürecinde uzaktan eğitim hizmetinden yararlanamayan öğrenci sayısının ciddi seviyelerde olduğu, bu anlamda fırsat eşitsizliğinin
